New research shows the cost has risen by almost 25 per cent since the start of the COVID-19 pandemic and it's expected to keep increasing, topping out at 27-per cent by year's end. items.title: INTERVIEW: America's diarrhoea dilemma turns deadly
items.summary: A widespread cyclosporiasis outbreak - which causes explosive diarrhoea - has grown into the largest on record in the United States and this week caused its first known deaths. Medical experts are warning that recent regulatory rollbacks have contributed to the infection's historic scale. The outbreak—now spanning at least nine states—has been sourced to iceberg lettuce from privately held Taylor Farms operations in central Mexico and served at Taco Bell restaurants. Cyclosporiasis, caused by an intestinal parasite, is generally not life-threatening, and the people who died had significant underlying health conditions that were exacerbated by severe dehydration. Gastroenterologist Dr Rabia De Latour is from the New York University Grossman School of Medicine and spoke to the Associated Press

items.title: Police hunt alleged 'far left' group that attacked Melbourne defence contractor
items.summary: Authorities are investigating an alleged terror attack on the outskirts of Melbourne, at Lovitt Technologies, which produces parts for F-35 Joint Strike Fighter jets. Australia's involvement in the global F-35 supply chain has been criticised in recent years because the US-made fighter jets have been used by Israel for attacks on Gaza. Law enforcement agencies allege the attackers have expressed support for Palestine, and targeted the facility due to its links in defence supply chains. They say the attack may have been motivated by anarchist and revolutionary ideology.
